records.command:
node scripts/model-benchmark-publish.mjs --input .dip-local/model-controlled-v5.json --output docs/benchmarks/2026-10-07-model-controlled-v5.json
node --disable-warning=ExperimentalWarning scripts/model-benchmark-evidence.mjs docs/benchmarks/2026-10-07-model-controlled-v5.json
node scripts/model-benchmark-summary.mjs --input docs/benchmarks/2026-10-07-model-controlled-v5.json --output docs/benchmarks/2026-10-07-model-summary-v5.json
Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $env:TEMP -Directory -Filter 'dip-model-controlled-*' | Sort-Object LastWriteTime -Descending | Select-Object -First 1 -ExpandProperty FullName
